observations: At0.4 the upper-right bank is more visibly divided into individually lit lobes and blue separations than at0.65 or0.9; its nearly uniform gray-roof appearance is weakened.
A visually crowded small-cloud layer remains toward the horizon; this is not a guarantee of a mostly clear sky.
Morphology ON keeps directional streaks and banks, whereas OFF retains more similarly rounded clusters.
recommendation: The0.4 morphology-ON combination is the strongest tiny-fixture direction and merits an actual-shore comparison if separately authorized. Keep production bounds/defaults unchanged pending that decision.
limitations: These are qualitative observations from actual192x108 images. No cloud-occupancy fraction is inferred from brightness or opaque alpha.
Derivative-selected cloud footprints differ from full-scene resolution.
Only the visible sky was rendered; reflection, cloud-shadow and PMREM renders were deliberately omitted.
Lowering the positive coverage control changes the density support and self-illumination; image coverage is not held constant.
